# VegSeal

> A trust-first vegan and vegetarian food scanner. Scan a barcode or ingredient label and instantly find out if a product is vegan, vegetarian, or contains animal ingredients.

VegSeal answers one question exceptionally well: can I eat this if I'm vegan or vegetarian? It never guesses — when an ingredient's origin is uncertain, it clearly says so.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Scan a product, search, and see recent scans.
- [Scan](/scan): Barcode scanner, ingredient photo scanner, and paste mode.
- [Search](/search): Search products by name or brand.
- [About](/about): What VegSeal is and how it works.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use.
